title: Longest String Chain
statement:
A word is a predecessor of another word if inserting exactly one lowercase letter anywhere in it produces the other word without reordering existing letters. A chain is a sequence in which each word is a predecessor of the next. Return the maximum chain length using words from the input.

## Examples

```text
Input: words = ["a", "b", "ba", "bca", "bda", "bdca"]
Output: 4
```

```text
Input: words = ["xbc", "pcxbcf", "xb", "cxbc", "pcxbc"]
Output: 5
```

```text
Input: words = ["abcd", "dbqca"]
Output: 1
```

## Constraints

- `1 <= words.length <= 1000`
- `1 <= words[i].length <= 16`
- Words contain only lowercase English letters.
